prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Fast-track adoption flows effectively improved onboarding metrics.
Reordering sign-in after pet adoption was helpful and won.
Spotlight layout changes on the final desktop welcome screen showed no clear effect.
Background rendering notification prompts showed no clear effect.
Predictions consistently overestimated the actual measured uplift across all tests.

Measured so far, by kind of change (relative change on the target step):
- adoption, new_flow: +9.3% over 1 test(s)
- finish, layout: +6.1% over 1 test(s)
- home, notification: +3.4% over 1 test(s)
- sign_in, reorder: +4.3% over 1 test(s)

Funnel:
- choose_path: 76.2%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 78.3%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 67.1%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 81.3%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 64.8%, median 395s / mean 5815s
- finishing onboarding overall: 21.1%

Return JSON {"scores": [{"index": i, "impact": n, "evidence": n, "confidence": n, "cost": n,
"predicted_lift": x, "note": short}]}

Changes:
0: [sign_in, copy] Existing Account Sync Assurance Banner: Update the sign-in screen headline and hint to explicitly assure users that signing in syncs existing pets across sessions. (why: 8 support emails (the top support theme) reported pets missing or reset after signing in again.)
1: [home, wait_info] Interactive Generation Progress & Tip Carousel: Add an active tip carousel and progress percentage to the waiting screen while the pet renders. (why: The waiting step (home) has high friction with a median wait of 201s and mean of 2336s, causing drop-off.)
2: [choose_path, layout] Split View Path Selection Screen: Switch path choice screen from standard layout to a side-by-side split comparison of preset vs custom paths. (why: Choose path takes a mean 514s and drops 23.8% of users due to decision hesitation.)
3: [adoption, hint] Photo Quality Assistant Callout: Provide real-time hints and asset badge overlays to guide photo selection on the custom pet step. (why: 3 support tickets noted custom pet generation failing or producing bad visual results.)
4: [sign_in, layout] Compact Single-Tap Sign In Screen: Change sign-in screen to a compact card layout with clear provider buttons to prevent screen stall confusion. (why: 2 support emails mentioned sign-in stalling, and the step shows a high mean duration (567s).)
5: [home, notification] Ready Alert Notification Sound & Prompt: Enable desktop notification sound and completion alerts when pet rendering finishes on the waiting screen. (why: Waiting step takes up to 2336s mean time; users leave the app backgrounded and forget to return.)
